skin: none (utilities only; glass scroll button from class strings)

oracle.notes: AI elements use plain Tailwind utilities, not cn-* skins. Structural classes converted to data-slot SASS.

propsInvented.name: height / maxHeight (Root)
propsInvented.why: Demos and chat shells need a bounded scrollport; source used class h-full / h-*.

propsInvented.name: threshold (Root)
propsInvented.why: Expose the 200px stick-to-bottom threshold used in context.

propsInvented.name: gap (Content)
propsInvented.why: Source demos switch gap-8 → gap-4 via class; no class merge in this library.

propsInvented.name: initial / resize (Root)
propsInvented.why: Declared in source but unused; now wired into StickToBottomContext for mount and resize scroll behaviors.

deviations.what: Content has overflow-y: auto + flex:1 (source only had flex flex-col gap p)
deviations.why: Without a scrollport, stick-to-bottom cannot function. Root stays overflow:hidden; Content is the scroll root.
deviations.risk: low — required for the advertised behaviour

deviations.what: Scroll button uses inline SVG, not phosphor/lucide
deviations.why: Library ships no icon dependency; keeps Button data-slot for full button skin.

deviations.what: Empty state data-slots renamed to conversation-empty-*
deviations.why: Avoid generic empty-title colliding with other empty surfaces.
role=log alone is weak for SR; polite live region improves streaming announcements.

status: comprehensive re-port — stick-to-bottom wired, streaming docs demos
